types.float: 32 bit floating point value.\nThe range is 1.175494351E-38 to 3.402823466E+38.
types.integer: 32 bit integer value.\n−2,147,483,648 and +2,147,483,647 (that is 0x80000000 to 0x7FFFFFFF in hex).
types.key: A 128 bit unique identifier (UUID).\nThe key is represented as hexidecimal characters (A-F and 0-9), grouped into sections (8,4,4,4,12 characters) and separated by hyphens (for a total of 36 characters). e.g. "A822FF2B-FF02-461D-B45D-DCD10A2DE0C2".
types.list: A collection of other data types.\nLists are signified by square brackets surrounding their elements; the elements inside are separated by commas. e.g. [0, 1, 2, 3, 4] or ["Yes", "No", "Perhaps"].
types.quaternion: Quaternion type is a left over from way back when LSL was created. It was later renamed to <rotation> to make it more user friendly, but it appears someone forgot to remove it ;-)
types.rotation: Rotation type is one of several ways to represent an orientation in 3D.\nIt is a mathematical object called a quaternion. You can think of a quaternion as four numbers (x, y, z, w), three of which represent the direction an object is facing and a fourth that represents the object's banking left or right around that direction.
types.string: Text data.\nThe editor accepts UTF-8 encoded text.
types.vector: A vector is a data type that contains a set of three float values.\nVectors are used to represent colors (RGB), positions, and directions/velocities.

llPointAt.tooltip: Directs the avatar owning the object to point at the vector pos.

arguments.name: sound

llPreloadSound.tooltip: Causes nearby viewers in range to preload the specified sound from the object's inventory to prevent playback delays.

arguments.name: options

llPursue.tooltip: Directs a pathfinding character to pursue and chase target, configured by the parameters specified in options.

arguments.tooltip: Key of the key-value pair to read.

llReadKeyValue.tooltip: Starts an asynchronous transaction to read the value associated with key k in the experience. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event. Fails with XP_ERROR_KEY_NOT_FOUND if the key does not exist.

llRefreshPrimURL.tooltip: Legacy function intended to reload the web page displayed on the prim's faces (currently non-functional).

llRegionSay.tooltip: Broadcasts the message msg to all scripts listening on channel Channel within the region. PUBLIC_CHANNEL (0) cannot be used, so, only scripts can receive the message.

arguments.name: channel

arguments.tooltip: Text message string to send.

llRegionSayTo.tooltip: Sends the message msg on Channel privately to the targeted agent or object (if within the region). If target is an agent and channel is non-zero, the message can also be heard by any attachments worn by the avatar.

arguments.name: avatar
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

llReleaseCamera.tooltip: Deprecated. Intended to return camera control back to the avatar (use llClearCameraParams instead).

llReleaseControls.tooltip: Stops taking inputs (previously acquired via llTakeControls) from the avatar, dequeuing any remaining control events and revoking the PERMISSION_TAKE_CONTROLS permission.

arguments.name: url
arguments.tooltip: URL string to release.

llReleaseURL.tooltip: Releases the specified url (previously obtained via llRequestURL), rendering it no longer usable.

llRemoteDataSetRegion.tooltip: Deprecated. Used with XML-RPC to reregister remote data channels if the object moves to another region.

arguments.name: avatar

llRemoveFromLandBanList.tooltip: Removes the specified avatar from the land parcel's ban list.

arguments.name: avatar

llRemoveFromLandPassList.tooltip: Removes the specified avatar from the land parcel's pass/access list.

arguments.name: item

llRemoveInventory.tooltip: Permanently deletes the named inventory item from the prim's inventory.

arguments.name: flags

llRemoveVehicleFlags.tooltip: Disables the specified vehicle flags (sets them to FALSE) using the bitwise mask flags.

arguments.name: agent_id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of an agent in the region participating in the experience.

arguments.name: transition
arguments.tooltip: Duration in seconds over which to transition to the new environment.

arguments.name: environment
arguments.tooltip: Name of an environmental setting in inventory, or its asset UUID (or empty string/NULL_KEY to clear).

llReplaceAgentEnvironment.tooltip: Replaces the region and parcel environment seen by the specified agent_id as part of an experience, transitioning the settings over transition seconds. Passing NULL_KEY or an empty string for environment restores defaults.

arguments.name: position
arguments.tooltip: Position vector of the target parcel (the Z component is ignored; use <-1.0, -1.0, -1.0> for the entire region).

arguments.name: environment
arguments.tooltip: Name of an environmental setting in inventory, or its asset UUID (or empty string/NULL_KEY to clear).

arguments.name: track_no
arguments.tooltip: The elevation track to change (0: water, 1: ground, 2: 1000m, 3: 2000m, 4: 3000m, -1: all tracks).

arguments.name: day_length
arguments.tooltip: Day cycle length in seconds (-1 to leave unchanged).

arguments.name: day_offset
arguments.tooltip: Day cycle offset in seconds from UTC (-1 to leave unchanged).

llReplaceEnvironment.tooltip: Replaces the environment on the parcel containing position (or the entire region if position is <-1.0, -1.0, -1.0>) for the specified track_no. Modifies day_length and day_offset if specified. Requires edit permissions on the parcel or estate management rights.

arguments.name: src
arguments.tooltip: Original source string to search.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.tooltip: Substring pattern to find and replace.

arguments.name: replacement_pattern
arguments.tooltip: New substring that replaces the pattern.

arguments.name: count
arguments.tooltip: Maximum number of replacements to make (0 for all, positive for left-to-right, negative for right-to-left).

llReplaceSubString.tooltip: Returns a copy of src with count occurrences of pattern replaced by replacement_pattern. Setting count to 0 replaces all occurrences; positive counts process left-to-right, while negative counts process right-to-left.

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the agent.

arguments.name: data
arguments.tooltip: DATA_* category flag of the requested information.

llRequestAgentData.tooltip: Asynchronously requests the specified data category (DATA_*) about the agent id. Triggers a dataserver event with the results and returns a key query handle.

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar to query.

llRequestDisplayName.tooltip: Asynchronously requests the display name of the agent specified by id, triggering a dataserver event with the results. The agent does not need to be online or in the region. Returns a key query handle.

arguments.name: agent
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the agent to request permissions from.

arguments.name: name
arguments.tooltip: Deprecated parameter (no longer used).

llRequestExperiencePermissions.tooltip: Requests permission from the specified agent to participate in the experience. These permissions are persistent and apply grid-wide across all scripts in the experience, automatically triggering experience_permissions or experience_permissions_denied.

arguments.name: item
arguments.tooltip: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

llRequestInventoryData.tooltip: Asynchronously requests data for the named inventory item, triggering a dataserver event. Currently, only landmark items are supported (which return local region coordinates). Returns a key query handle.

arguments.name: agent
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the agent in the same region.

arguments.name: permissions
arguments.tooltip: Bitfield containing the PERMISSION_* constants to request.

llRequestPermissions.tooltip: Requests permissions (a bitfield specified by permissions) from the agent in the same region, calling run_time_permissions if granted. This call does not pause script execution.

llRequestSecureURL.tooltip: Asynchronously requests one secure HTTPS (SSL, port 12043) URL for use by this object, triggering an http_request event. Returns a key query handle.

arguments.name: region
arguments.tooltip: Case-sensitive region name.

arguments.name: data
arguments.tooltip: DATA_SIM_* flag of the requested simulator data.

llRequestSimulatorData.tooltip: Asynchronously requests data (using a DATA_SIM_* constant) about the region. Triggers a dataserver event and returns a key query handle.

llRequestURL.tooltip: Asynchronously requests one HTTP URL for use by this script, triggering an http_request event. Returns a key query handle.

arguments.name: username
arguments.tooltip: Current or historical username of the avatar to resolve.

llRequestUserKey.tooltip: Asynchronously requests the Agent ID key (UUID) for the agent specified by their current or historical username, returning NULL_KEY if not found. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event.

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar to query.

llRequestUsername.tooltip: Asynchronously requests the unique single-word username of the agent identified by id, triggering a dataserver event. The agent does not need to be online or in the region. Returns a key query handle.

arguments.name: anim_state
arguments.tooltip: Animation state string (or 'ALL') to reset.

llResetAnimationOverride.tooltip: Resets the animation override for anim_state to its default value (use 'ALL' to reset all states). Requires the PERMISSION_OVERRIDE_ANIMATIONS permission.

llResetLandBanList.tooltip: Removes all blocked residents from the land parcel's ban list.

llResetLandPassList.tooltip: Removes all residents from the land parcel's access/pass list.

arguments.name: script
arguments.tooltip: Name of the target script in the prim's inventory.

llResetOtherScript.tooltip: Resets the named script name in the prim's inventory.

llResetTime.tooltip: Resets the script's elapsed time timer back to zero.

arguments.name: objects
arguments.tooltip: A list of object UUID keys to return.

llReturnObjectsByID.tooltip: Returns objects specified by the list of UUIDs objects to their owners. Requires the PERMISSION_RETURN_OBJECTS permission, and the script owner must own the parcel or be an estate manager/region owner.

arguments.name: owner
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar or group whose objects will be returned.

arguments.name: scope
arguments.tooltip: OBJECT_RETURN_* scope flag (such as OBJECT_RETURN_PARCEL, OBJECT_RETURN_PARCEL_OWNER, or OBJECT_RETURN_REGION).

llReturnObjectsByOwner.tooltip: Returns objects owned by owner within the specified scope (parcel, parcel owner, or region). Requires the PERMISSION_RETURN_OBJECTS permission, and the script owner must own the parcel or be an estate manager/region owner.

arguments.name: item
arguments.tooltip: Name of the object in the prim's inventory to rez.

arguments.name: pos

arguments.name: vel
arguments.tooltip: Initial velocity vector for the rezzed object.

arguments.name: rot
arguments.tooltip: Initial rotation of the rezzed object.

arguments.name: start_param
arguments.tooltip: Start parameter passed to the rezzed object's on_rez event (accessible via llGetStartParameter).

llRezAtRoot.tooltip: Instantiates the named inventory object with the root prim at pos with velocity vel and rotation rot, passing start_param as the on_rez start parameter. The vel parameter is ignored if the rezzed object is non-physical.

arguments.name: item
arguments.tooltip: Name of the object in the prim's inventory to rez.

arguments.name: pos
arguments.tooltip: Position vector in region coordinates where the center of the object will be placed.

arguments.name: vel
arguments.tooltip: Initial velocity vector (maximum magnitude ~200m/s).

arguments.name: rot
arguments.tooltip: Initial rotation of the rezzed object.

arguments.name: start_param
arguments.tooltip: Start parameter passed to the rezzed object's on_rez event (accessible via llGetStartParameter).

llRezObject.tooltip: Instantiates the named inventory object with the bounding box centered at pos with velocity vel and rotation rot, passing param as the on_rez start parameter. The vel parameter is ignored if the rezzed object is non-physical.

arguments.name: item
arguments.tooltip: Name of the object in the prim's inventory to rez.

arguments.name: options
arguments.tooltip: A list of REZ_* options to configure the rezzed object's attributes.

llRezObjectWithParams.tooltip: Instantiates the named inventory object (defaulting to the rezzing prim's position unless REZ_POS is specified) using the initial set of parameters specified in options. Returns the key of the rezzed object, or a blank key on failure.

arguments.name: q
arguments.tooltip: Rotation to evaluate.

llRot2Angle.tooltip: Returns the angle, in radians, that q rotates.

arguments.name: q
arguments.tooltip: Rotation to evaluate.

llRot2Axis.tooltip: Returns the unit vector axis that q rotates around.

arguments.tooltip: Rotation to convert.

llRot2Euler.tooltip: Returns a vector of Euler angles (roll, pitch, yaw) of q. The angles will be in radians.

llRot2Fwd.tooltip: Returns the unit vector pointing toward positive X (forward) in the coordinate space of rotation q. Equivalent to <1, 0, 0> * q.

llRot2Left.tooltip: Returns the unit vector pointing toward positive Y (left) in the coordinate space of rotation q. Equivalent to <0, 1, 0> * q.

arguments.name: q
arguments.tooltip: Rotation to convert.

llRot2Up.tooltip: Returns the unit vector pointing toward positive Z (up) in the coordinate space of rotation q. Equivalent to <0, 0, 1> * q.

arguments.name: start_vec

arguments.name: end_vec

llRotBetween.tooltip: Returns the shortest-path quaternion that rotates start_vec onto end_vec.

arguments.name: target_direction
arguments.tooltip: Target rotation to align the object with.

arguments.name: strength
arguments.tooltip: Force of rotation (0.0 cancels the tracking; values around half the object's mass are typical).

arguments.name: damping
arguments.tooltip: Timescale in seconds to critically damp the rotation.

llRotLookAt.tooltip: Causes the object to smoothly rotate to target_direction with a force defined by strength and damping. A strength of 0.0 cancels the rotation target. Rotation is maintained until stopped with llStopLookAt.

arguments.name: rot
arguments.tooltip: Target rotation to track.

arguments.name: error
arguments.tooltip: Tolerance angle in radians defining when the target rotation is considered reached.

llRotTarget.tooltip: Registers the rotation rot with a leeway tolerance error (in radians) as a target, triggering at_rot_target and not_at_rot_target events. Returns an integer handle to unregister the target via llRotTargetRemove.

arguments.name: handle
arguments.tooltip: Integer target handle returned by llRotTarget to remove.

llRotTargetRemove.tooltip: Removes the rotational target specified by the integer handle registered with llRotTarget.

arguments.name: angle
arguments.tooltip: Rotation angle expressed in radians.

arguments.name: face
arguments.tooltip: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

llRotateTexture.tooltip: Sets the texture rotation of face to the specified angle (in radians). If face is ALL_SIDES, rotates the texture on all faces.

arguments.name: val
arguments.tooltip: Number to round.

llRound.tooltip: Returns val rounded to the nearest integer. Halfway values are rounded toward infinity.

arguments.name: src
arguments.tooltip: Source string to hash.

llSHA1String.tooltip: Returns a string of 40 hex characters representing the SHA-1 security hash of src.

arguments.name: src
arguments.tooltip: Source string to hash.

llSHA256String.tooltip: Returns a string of 64 hex characters representing the SHA-256 security hash of src.

arguments.name: uuid
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the group, avatar, or prim to check.

llSameGroup.tooltip: Returns TRUE if the agent or object specified by uuid is in the same region (simulator) and shares the same active group as the prim containing the script; returns FALSE otherwise.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.tooltip: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) to chat the message on.

arguments.name: msg
arguments.tooltip: Text message string to broadcast.

llSay.tooltip: Broadcasts the message msg to all scripts or agents listening on channel within llGetEnv("chat_range"), which is 20m on most regions. Agents listen on PUBLIC_CHANNEL (0) and DEBUG_CHANNEL (2147483647). All other channels are for script-to-script communication.

arguments.name: scaling_factor
arguments.tooltip: Multiplier scale factor to apply to the prim sizes and their local positions.

llScaleByFactor.tooltip: Attempts to uniformly resize the entire object by scaling_factor, maintaining size-position ratios of the prims. Fails if the linkset is physical, a pathfinding character, in keyframed motion, would exceed prim scale/linkability limits, or would overflow parcel capacity.

arguments.name: u
arguments.tooltip: Horizontal (U) texture repeats scale value, in the interval [-100.0, 100.0].

arguments.name: v
arguments.tooltip: Vertical (V) texture repeats scale value, in the interval [-100.0, 100.0].

arguments.name: face
arguments.tooltip: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

llScaleTexture.tooltip: Sets the diffuse texture horizontal u and vertical v scales (repeats) on the specified face of the prim. Setting face to ALL_SIDES updates all sides. Negative scale values flip the texture.

arguments.name: pos
arguments.tooltip: Position vector in region coordinates to check.

llScriptDanger.tooltip: Returns TRUE if the vector position pos is over public land, sandbox land, land restricting edit/build permissions, or land that disables outside scripts.

arguments.name: flags
arguments.tooltip: PROFILE_* flag (such as PROFILE_NONE or PROFILE_SCRIPT_MEMORY) to set the profiling state.

llScriptProfiler.tooltip: Enables or disables the script's profiling state using flags (supports PROFILE_SCRIPT_MEMORY on Mono, or PROFILE_NONE). Active profiling can significantly reduce script performance.

arguments.name: channel

arguments.tooltip: Maximum distance in meters to scan (range [0.0, 96.0]).

llSensorRemove.tooltip: Removes the periodic sensor previously configured by llSensorRepeat.

arguments.tooltip: UUID of the agent participating in the experience.

arguments.name: transition
arguments.tooltip: Transition duration in seconds.

arguments.tooltip: A list of environmental parameters to apply.

llSetAgentEnvironment.tooltip: Sets an individual agent's environmental settings using the attributes in params over a duration of transition seconds. Must be used as part of an experience; passing an empty list removes overrides.

arguments.name: rot
arguments.tooltip: Target rotation to turn the avatar to face.

arguments.name: flags
arguments.tooltip: Flags to configure the rotation behavior.

llSetAgentRot.tooltip: Sets the rotation of the avatar to rot, controlled by flags.

arguments.name: alpha
arguments.tooltip: Transparency value to set, from 0.0 (clear) to 1.0 (solid; clamped to a minimum of 0.1).

llSetAlpha.tooltip: Sets the diffuse texture alpha (opacity) of face. If face is ALL_SIDES, applies to all faces. Values are clamped between 0.1 and 1.0 (where 1.0 is fully opaque).

arguments.name: initial_omega
arguments.tooltip: Angular velocity vector to apply (in radians per second).

arguments.name: is_local
arguments.tooltip: Boolean. If TRUE, initial_omega is treated as a local vector; if FALSE, as a global region vector.

llSetAngularVelocity.tooltip: Sets the angular velocity of a physical object to initial_omega (mass-independent). If local is TRUE, applied in local coordinates; if FALSE, applied in global coordinates. Has no effect on non-physical objects.

arguments.name: anim_state
arguments.tooltip: Animation state to override.

arguments.name: anim
arguments.tooltip: Name of an animation in the prim's inventory, or a built-in animation name.

llSetAnimationOverride.tooltip: Overrides the default animation for anim_state with anim (which must be in the object's inventory or a built-in animation). Requires the PERMISSION_OVERRIDE_ANIMATIONS permission.

arguments.name: buoyancy
arguments.tooltip: Float buoyancy value to set.

llSetBuoyancy.tooltip: Sets the buoyancy of a physical object (requires physics to be enabled). A value of 0.0 offers no buoyancy, < 1.0 sinks, 1.0 counteracts gravity, and > 1.0 rises.

arguments.name: offset
arguments.tooltip: Offset position vector in local coordinates relative to the prim.

llSetCameraAtOffset.tooltip: Sets the target offset vector (in local coordinates) that a seated avatar's camera will look at.

arguments.name: offset
arguments.tooltip: Offset position vector in local coordinates relative to the prim.

llSetCameraEyeOffset.tooltip: Sets the eye offset vector (in local coordinates) where a seated avatar's camera is positioned.

arguments.name: rules
arguments.tooltip: A strided list of rules and data pairs configuring the camera.

llSetCameraParams.tooltip: Sets multiple camera parameters simultaneously using the list of rules. Requires the PERMISSION_CONTROL_CAMERA runtime permission.

arguments.name: action
arguments.tooltip: CLICK_ACTION_* flag representing the action to apply.

llSetClickAction.tooltip: Sets the action (a CLICK_ACTION_* flag) performed when an avatar left-clicks the prim.

arguments.name: color
arguments.tooltip: Color vector in RGB <R, G, B> (values from 0.0 to 1.0).

arguments.name: face
arguments.tooltip: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

llSetColor.tooltip: Sets the Blinn-Phong diffuse RGB color of face. If face is ALL_SIDES, applies the color to all faces.

arguments.name: request_id
arguments.tooltip: Unique key identifying the incoming HTTP request.

arguments.name: content_type
arguments.tooltip: CONTENT_TYPE_* constant representing the Internet media type to use.

llSetContentType.tooltip: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent HTTP server responses (via llHTTPResponse) for request_id using the specified content_type (a CONTENT_TYPE_* constant).

arguments.name: damage
arguments.tooltip: Float damage value to set (range -100.0 for full heal to 100.0 for instant kill).

llSetDamage.tooltip: Sets the amount of damage delivered when this object hits an avatar. The object is immediately destroyed upon inflicting damage, and no collision event is triggered.

arguments.name: position
arguments.tooltip: Position vector in region coordinates to specify the target parcel, or <-1.0, -1.0, z> for the entire region (where z specifies the sky track, or -1 for all tracks).

arguments.name: params
arguments.tooltip: A list of environmental attributes and values to apply (or empty to clear).

llSetEnvironment.tooltip: Overrides the environmental settings at position for a parcel (or region if position is <-1.0, -1.0, z>) using the parameters in params. Passing an empty params list removes previous overrides.

arguments.name: force
arguments.tooltip: Directional force vector to apply.

arguments.name: is_local
arguments.tooltip: Boolean. If TRUE, force is treated as a local vector; if FALSE, as a global region vector.

llSetForce.tooltip: Applies a constant linear force to a physical object. If local is TRUE, force is applied relative to local coordinates; if FALSE, applied relative to region coordinates.

arguments.name: force
arguments.tooltip: Directional linear force vector.

arguments.name: torque
arguments.tooltip: Torque rotational force vector.

arguments.name: is_local
arguments.tooltip: Boolean. If TRUE, force and torque are treated as local vectors; if FALSE, as global region vectors.

llSetForceAndTorque.tooltip: Sets both the constant linear force and constant torque acting on a physical object. If local is TRUE, forces are applied in local coordinates; if FALSE, in global coordinates.

arguments.name: changes
arguments.tooltip: A list of terrain detail properties and values to change.

llSetGroundTexture.tooltip: Changes the painted terrain textures on the region based on changes. The script owner must have estate management rights. Returns an integer status.

arguments.name: height
arguments.tooltip: Distance to hover above the ground or water.

arguments.name: water
arguments.tooltip: Boolean. If TRUE, hovers above water too; if FALSE, water is ignored.

arguments.name: material

arguments.name: options
arguments.tooltip: A list of key-value pairs specifying the character's new configuration options (takes same constants as llCreateCharacter).

llUpdateCharacter.tooltip: Updates settings for a pathfinding character using the parameters specified in options.

arguments.name: k
arguments.tooltip: Key of the key-value pair to update.

arguments.name: v
arguments.tooltip: New value for the key-value pair.

arguments.name: checked
arguments.tooltip: Boolean. If TRUE, requires the existing value to match original_value to complete the update; if FALSE, creates the key if needed.

arguments.name: original_value
arguments.tooltip: String value to compare against the existing value in the datastore.

llUpdateKeyValue.tooltip: Starts an asynchronous transaction to update the key k to value v inside the experience datastore. If checked is TRUE, the update fails with XP_ERROR_RETRY_UPDATE unless the existing value matches original_value.

arguments.name: vec_a
arguments.tooltip: First vector.

arguments.name: vec_b
arguments.tooltip: Second vector.

llVecDist.tooltip: Returns a float representing the undirected, non-negative distance between vectors vec_a and vec_b.

arguments.name: vec
arguments.tooltip: Vector to evaluate.

llVecMag.tooltip: Returns the magnitude (geometric length) of vec.

arguments.name: vec
arguments.tooltip: Vector to normalize.

llVecNorm.tooltip: Returns the normalized unit vector pointing the same direction as vec. If <0, 0, 0>, return <0, 0, 0>.

arguments.name: public_key
arguments.tooltip: PEM-formatted public key to use for signature verification.

arguments.name: msg
arguments.tooltip: Message string that was signed.

arguments.name: signature
arguments.tooltip: Base64-encoded signature to verify.

arguments.name: algorithm
arguments.tooltip: Cryptographic digest algorithm to use.

llVerifyRSA.tooltip: Returns TRUE if the Base64-formatted signature is verified as valid for the message msg when using the digest algorithm and public_key. Returns FALSE otherwise.

arguments.name: detect
arguments.tooltip: Boolean. If TRUE, enables VolumeDetect; if FALSE (default), disables it.

llVolumeDetect.tooltip: If detect is TRUE, enables VolumeDetect (object becomes phantom and physical objects/avatars can pass through it). Triggers collision_start on initial intersection and collision_end when intersection stops (standard collision events are suppressed while intersecting).

arguments.name: origin
arguments.tooltip: Center coordinate position vector to wander about.

arguments.name: dist
arguments.tooltip: A vector specifying the maximum distance limits (half-extents) along each world-aligned axis from the origin.

arguments.name: options
arguments.tooltip: A list of WANDER_* flags and parameters to configure the wander behavior.

llWanderWithin.tooltip: Directs a pathfinding character to wander around a central coordinate origin, restricted within the bounding distance limits of dist and configured by options.

arguments.name: offset
arguments.tooltip: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

llWater.tooltip: Returns a float representing the water height directly below the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.tooltip: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) to whisper the message on.

arguments.name: msg
arguments.tooltip: Text message string to broadcast.

llWhisper.tooltip: Broadcasts the message msg to all scripts or agents listening on channel within llGetEnv("whisper_range"), which is 10m on most regions. Agents listen on PUBLIC_CHANNEL (0) and DEBUG_CHANNEL (2147483647). All other channels are for script-to-script communication.

arguments.name: offset
arguments.tooltip: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

llWind.tooltip: Returns a vector representing the wind velocity at the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

arguments.name: world_pos
arguments.tooltip: World-frame position vector to project into HUD space.

llWorldPosToHUD.tooltip: Returns the local position vector that places the center of the HUD object directly over the world coordinate world_pos as viewed by the current camera. Requires the PERMISSION_TRACK_CAMERA runtime permission.

arguments.name: str1
arguments.tooltip: First Base64 string.

arguments.name: str2
arguments.tooltip: Second Base64 string (will repeat if shorter than str1).

llXorBase64.tooltip: Correctly performs a bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) on Base64 strings str1 and str2, returning the result as a Base64 string. The string str2 repeats if it is shorter than str1.

arguments.name: str1
arguments.tooltip: First Base64 string.

arguments.name: str2
arguments.tooltip: Second Base64 string (will repeat if shorter than str1).

llXorBase64Strings.tooltip: Deprecated (use llXorBase64 instead). Retained for backwards compatibility. Incorrectly performs a bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) on Base64 strings str1 and str2.

arguments.name: str1
arguments.tooltip: First Base64 string.

arguments.name: str2
arguments.tooltip: Second Base64 string (will repeat if shorter than str1).

llXorBase64StringsCorrect.tooltip: Deprecated (use llXorBase64 instead). Correctly performs (unless nulls are present) a bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) on Base64 strings str1 and str2.

arguments.name: color
arguments.tooltip: Color vector in the sRGB colorspace to convert.

llsRGB2Linear.tooltip: Returns a linear RGB colorspace vector converted from the sRGB colorspace argument.

state_entry.tooltip: Triggered immediately whenever a new state is entered (including at script start). It is always the first event handled.

state_exit.tooltip: Triggered when the state command is used to transition out of the current state. Handled before entering the new state's state_entry.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of touching agents detected (usable with llDetected* functions).

touch_start.tooltip: Triggered when an avatar first touches the object. Passes num_detected, representing the number of touching agents.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of touching agents detected (usable with llDetected* functions).

touch.tooltip: Triggered continuously while an avatar touches the object. Passes num_detected, representing the number of touching agents.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of touching agents detected (usable with llDetected* functions).

touch_end.tooltip: Triggered when an avatar stops touching the object. Passes num_detected, representing the number of touching agents.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of detected colliders (usable with llDetected* functions).

collision_start.tooltip: Triggered when an avatar or another object first begins colliding with the object containing the script. Passes num_detected, representing the number of detected collisions.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of detected colliders (usable with llDetected* functions).

collision.tooltip: Triggered continuously while an avatar or another object is colliding with the object containing the script. Passes num_detected, representing the number of detected collisions.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of detected colliders (usable with llDetected* functions).

collision_end.tooltip: Triggered when an avatar or another object stops colliding with the object containing the script. Passes num_detected, representing the number of detected collisions.

arguments.name: pos
arguments.tooltip: Vector position of collision with the ground.

land_collision_start.tooltip: Triggered in the root prim when a physical object or attached avatar first begins colliding with the ground at position pos.

arguments.name: pos
arguments.tooltip: Vector position of collision with the ground.

land_collision.tooltip: Triggered in the root prim when a physical object or attached avatar is colliding with the ground at position pos.

arguments.name: pos
arguments.tooltip: Vector position of the last ground collision.

land_collision_end.tooltip: Triggered in the root prim when a physical object or attached avatar stops colliding with the ground at position pos.

timer.tooltip: Triggered at regular periodic intervals configured by llSetTimerEvent.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.tooltip: Chat channel where the message appeared.

arguments.name: name
arguments.tooltip: Name of the sending prim or the legacy name of the sending agent.

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the sending agent or prim.

arguments.name: msg
arguments.tooltip: Spoken text string.

listen.tooltip: Triggered when a chat message matching active llListen filters is received on channel. Passes the sender's name and UUID key id, along with the spoken string msg.

arguments.name: start_param
arguments.tooltip: Integer start parameter passed from the rezzing call.

on_rez.tooltip: Triggered when the object is rezzed into the world (by a script or user). Passes start_param from the rezzing call (or 0 if rezzed from inventory). Also triggers on attachments during login or when attached from inventory.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of detected targets found (usable with llDetected* functions).

sensor.tooltip: Triggered when objects matching constraints of llSensor or llSensorRepeat are successfully detected. Passes num_detected, representing the number of detected targets.

no_sensor.tooltip: Triggered when active sensors (from llSensor or llSensorRepeat) complete a scan without finding any matching targets.

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar whose inputs are captured.

arguments.name: level
arguments.tooltip: A bitfield of CONTROL_* constants representing currently held controls.

arguments.name: edge
arguments.tooltip: A bitfield of CONTROL_* constants representing controls that just changed state.

control.tooltip: Triggered to pass captured avatar control inputs into the script. The parameter level indicates held controls, and edge indicates change in controls (both are bitfields of CONTROL_* constants).

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the paying resident.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.tooltip: Quantity of L$ paid to the prim.

money.tooltip: Triggered when a resident specified by id pays an amount of Linden dollars (L$) to the prim.

arguments.name: time
arguments.tooltip: Timestamp of when the email was received, in (string)llGetUnixTime() format.

arguments.name: address
arguments.tooltip: Email address of the sender.

arguments.name: subject
arguments.tooltip: Subject of the email.

arguments.name: msg
arguments.tooltip: Body text of the email.

arguments.name: num_left
arguments.tooltip: Number of emails still waiting in the queue.

email.tooltip: Receive an email requested by llGetNextEmail(). NumberRemaining indicates the number of emails remaining in the queue for llGetNextEmail() to retrieve.

arguments.name: tnum
arguments.tooltip: Integer target handle returned by the llTarget call.

arguments.name: targetpos
arguments.tooltip: Target position vector specified in the llTarget call.

arguments.name: ourpos
arguments.tooltip: Current position vector of the object (similar to llGetPos).

at_target.tooltip: Triggered when the scripted object's position (ourpos) comes within the defined range of the target position (targetpos) set by llTarget (which returns the associated handle tnum).

not_at_target.tooltip: Triggered continuously while the object's position has not yet reached the range of targets set via llTarget.

arguments.name: handle
arguments.tooltip: Integer handle returned by the llRotTarget call.

arguments.name: targetrot
arguments.tooltip: Target rotation specified in the llRotTarget call.

arguments.name: ourrot
arguments.tooltip: Current rotation of the object (similar to llGetRot).

at_rot_target.tooltip: Triggered when the script's rotation (ourrot) comes within a defined angle (error) of the target rotation (targetrot) set by a call to llRotTarget (which returns the associated handle).

not_at_rot_target.tooltip: Triggered continuously while the object's rotation is outside the leeway angle of targets set via llRotTarget.

arguments.name: perm
arguments.tooltip: Bitfield of currently granted permissions (PERMISSION_* flags).

run_time_permissions.tooltip: Triggered when an agent grants or denies runtime permissions requested by llRequestPermissions. Passes the active integer permissions bitfield perm (returns 0 if no permissions are currently granted).

arguments.name: changes
arguments.tooltip: A bitfield of CHANGED_* flags representing what changed.

changed.tooltip: Triggered when various properties of the object change. The parameter changes is a bitfield of CHANGED_* flags.

arguments.name: avatar
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar the object is attached to, or NULL_KEY if detached.

attach.tooltip: Triggered whenever the object is attached to or detached from an avatar. Passes the UUID key of the avatar if attached, or NULL_KEY if detached.

arguments.name: queryid
arguments.tooltip: Key identifying the asynchronous request (matches the handle returned by the requesting function).

arguments.name: data
arguments.tooltip: String containing the requested data.

dataserver.tooltip: Triggered when requested data is returned to the script (e.g., from llRequestAgentData, llRequestInventoryData, or llGetNotecardLine).

arguments.name: sender_num
arguments.tooltip: Link index of the prim containing the script that sent the message.

arguments.name: num
arguments.tooltip: An integer value passed from the sending script.

arguments.name: str
arguments.tooltip: A text string value passed from the sending script.

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: A key value passed from the sending script.

link_message.tooltip: Triggered when the script receives a link message from sender_num, containing the parameters num, str, and id sent via llMessageLinked.

moving_start.tooltip: Triggered whenever the physical or moving object containing the script starts moving.

moving_end.tooltip: Triggered whenever the physical or moving object containing the script stops moving.

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the newly rezzed object.

object_rez.tooltip: Triggered when this object successfully rezzes another object from its inventory. Passes the key (UUID) id of the newly rezzed object.

arguments.name: event_type
arguments.tooltip: Integer constant representing the type of XML-RPC event.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.tooltip: XML-RPC channel ID key.

arguments.name: message_id
arguments.tooltip: XML-RPC message ID key.

arguments.name: sender
arguments.tooltip: XML-RPC sender string.

arguments.name: idata
arguments.tooltip: Payload integer data.

arguments.name: sdata
arguments.tooltip: Payload string data.

remote_data.tooltip: Deprecated. Triggered by incoming XML-RPC calls, passing event_type, channel, message_id, sender, idata, and sdata.

arguments.name: request_id
arguments.tooltip: Key matching the handle returned by the initiating llHTTPRequest call.

arguments.name: status
arguments.tooltip: Integer HTTP status code returned (such as 200 or 404).

arguments.name: metadata
arguments.tooltip: A list of HTTP_* constants and response headers metadata.

arguments.name: body
arguments.tooltip: String payload of the received response body.

http_response.tooltip: Triggered when an HTTP response body is received for a pending request_id, or if the request fails or times out.

arguments.name: request_id
arguments.tooltip: Unique key identifying the incoming HTTP request (used with llHTTPResponse).

arguments.name: method
arguments.tooltip: HTTP method string ('GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE') or URL request status constants.

arguments.name: body
arguments.tooltip: String payload of the incoming request body.

http_request.tooltip: Triggered when the script's registered URL receives an incoming HTTP request identified by request_id.

arguments.name: agent_id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar approving experience permissions.

experience_permissions.tooltip: Triggered when the agent specified by agent_id approves an experience permissions request (interactively or automatically if previously approved).

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: Key matching the handle returned by the initiating llTransfer* function.

arguments.name: success
arguments.tooltip: Boolean. TRUE if the L$ transfer succeeded, FALSE otherwise.

arguments.name: data
arguments.tooltip: Contains a CSV string of transaction info on success, or an error string on failure.

transaction_result.tooltip: Triggered when an asynchronous L$ transfer (such as llTransferLindenDollars) is completed. Passes transaction info id, success status, and CSV or error data.

arguments.name: type
arguments.tooltip: Path update status or failure code constant (PU_* flag).

arguments.name: reserved
arguments.tooltip: Reserved parameter (currently unused).

path_update.tooltip: Triggered to inform the script of changes or failures in the pathfinding character's status.

arguments.name: agent_id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar who denied or was blocked from granting permissions.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.tooltip: XP_ERROR_* error constant describing why permissions were denied.

experience_permissions_denied.tooltip: Triggered when the agent specified by agent_id denies experience permissions, or when permission is blocked for other reasons (specified by the error code reason).

arguments.name: action
arguments.tooltip: Action taken (LINKSETDATA_UPDATE, LINKSETDATA_DELETE, LINKSETDATA_MULTIDELETE, or LINKSETDATA_RESET).

arguments.name: name
arguments.tooltip: Name of the modified key (a comma-separated list of keys for LINKSETDATA_MULTIDELETE, or empty for LINKSETDATA_RESET).

arguments.name: value
arguments.tooltip: New value of the key (empty if the key was deleted or is protected).

linkset_data.tooltip: Fires in all scripts in the linkset whenever the linkset datastore is modified via an llLinksetData function. Passes the action taken, the affected key name, and the new value.

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar supplying controller input.

arguments.name: button_levels
arguments.tooltip: A 32-bit mask representing the canonical buttons currently held down on the controller.

arguments.name: axes
arguments.tooltip: A list of six float values in the range [-1.0, 1.0] representing canonical controller axes.

game_control.tooltip: Triggered when a compatible viewer sends game controller input changes for the avatar specified by id. Only triggers for scripts in attachments or seats.

on_death.tooltip: Triggered on all worn attachments when the wearing avatar's health reaches 0.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Number of pending damage events.

on_damage.tooltip: Triggered when damage has been inflicted on an avatar or task, but before it is applied or distributed. Collision detected functions (llDetected*), llDetectedDamage, and llAdjustDamage are available. Passes num_detected, representing the number of pending damage events.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Number of damage events applied to the avatar or task.

final_damage.tooltip: Triggered after all on_damage events across all scripts have completed and damage is actively applied to the avatar or distributed among seated avatars. Collision detected functions (llDetected*) and llDetectedDamage are available.

ACTIVE.tooltip: Objects running a script or physically moving (using server resources). In llDetectedType(), it identifies physical objects and agents. In llSensor() or llSensorRepeat(), it searches for moving physical objects or scripted objects.

AGENT.tooltip: Agents (avatars). In llDetectedType, it indicates an avatar. In llSensor or llSensorRepeat, it searches for avatars by legacy name (functionally identical to AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME, though using AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME is recommended instead).

AGENT_ALWAYS_RUN.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the queried avatar has 'Always Run' enabled or is using tap-tap-hold.

AGENT_ATTACHMENTS.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the queried avatar has attachments.

AGENT_AUTOMATED.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to identify if the avatar is registered with Linden Lab as an automated/scripted agent (bot).

AGENT_AUTOPILOT.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in autopilot mode, which is enabled when the user selects 'Go Here' on the ground or uses double-click autopilot.

AGENT_AWAY.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in 'away' mode, which indicates they toggled away or have been inactive for too long.

AGENT_BUSY.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in 'busy' mode.

AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME.tooltip: Used to find agents by legacy name. In llDetectedType, it indicates an avatar. In llSensor or llSensorRepeat, it searches for avatars by legacy name.

AGENT_BY_USERNAME.tooltip: Used to find agents by username (see Avatar Names).

AGENT_CROUCHING.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is crouching.

AGENT_FLOATING_VIA_SCRIPTED_ATTACHMENT.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is floating or hovering because of a scripted attachment using either llSetHoverHeight or llGroundRepel.

AGENT_FLYING.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the queried avatar is flying or hovering.

AGENT_IN_AIR.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in the air (jumping, flying, or falling).

AGENT_LIST_PARCEL.tooltip: Agents on the same parcel where the script is running.

AGENT_LIST_PARCEL_OWNER.tooltip: Agents on any parcel in the region where the parcel owner is the same as the owner of the parcel under the scripted object.

AGENT_LIST_REGION.tooltip: Returns any or all agents in the region.

AGENT_MOUSELOOK.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in mouselook.

AGENT_ON_OBJECT.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is sitting on an object and linked to it.

AGENT_SCRIPTED.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is carrying scripted objects or has scripted attachments.

AGENT_SITTING.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is sitting.

AGENT_TYPING.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is typing.

AGENT_WALKING.tooltip: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the queried avatar is walking, running, or crouch walking.

ALL_SIDES.tooltip: Selects all sides of an object in an applicable function.

ANIM_ON.tooltip: Enables texture animation. This must be set to start the animation and cleared to stop it.

ATTACH_ANY_HUD.tooltip: A special constant representing all HUD attachment points when filtering for any HUD attachment.

ATTACH_AVATAR_CENTER.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's geometric center or root.

ATTACH_BACK.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's back.

ATTACH_BELLY.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's belly, stomach, or tummy.

ATTACH_CHEST.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's chest or sternum.

ATTACH_CHIN.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's chin.

ATTACH_FACE_JAW.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's jaw.

ATTACH_FACE_LEAR.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left ear (extended).

ATTACH_FACE_LEYE.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left eye (extended).

ATTACH_FACE_REAR.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right ear (extended).

ATTACH_FACE_REYE.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right eye (extended).

ATTACH_FACE_TONGUE.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's tongue.

ATTACH_GROIN.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's groin.

ATTACH_HEAD.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's head.

ATTACH_HIND_LFOOT.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left hind foot.

ATTACH_HIND_RFOOT.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right hind foot.

ATTACH_HUD_BOTTOM_LEFT.tooltip: Attachment point for HUD Bottom Left.

ATTACH_HUD_BOTTOM_RIGHT.tooltip: Attachment point for HUD Bottom Right.

ATTACH_HUD_TOP_CENTER.tooltip: Attachment point for HUD Top Center.

ATTACH_HUD_TOP_LEFT.tooltip: Attachment point for HUD Top Left.

ATTACH_HUD_TOP_RIGHT.tooltip: Attachment point for HUD Top Right.

ATTACH_LEAR.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left ear.

ATTACH_LEFT_PEC.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left pectoral.

ATTACH_LEYE.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left eye.

ATTACH_LFOOT.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left foot.

ATTACH_LHAND.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left hand.

ATTACH_LHAND_RING1.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left ring finger.

ATTACH_LHIP.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left hip.

ATTACH_LLARM.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left lower arm.

ATTACH_LLLEG.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left lower leg.

ATTACH_LPEC.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right pectoral (deprecated, use ATTACH_RIGHT_PEC).

ATTACH_LSHOULDER.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left shoulder.

ATTACH_LUARM.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left upper arm.

ATTACH_LULEG.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left upper leg.

ATTACH_LWING.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left wing.

ATTACH_MOUTH.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's mouth.

ATTACH_NECK.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's neck.

ATTACH_NOSE.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's nose.

ATTACH_PELVIS.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's pelvis.

ATTACH_REAR.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right ear.

ATTACH_REYE.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right eye.

ATTACH_RFOOT.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right foot.

ATTACH_RHAND.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right hand (the default attachment point).

ATTACH_RHAND_RING1.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right ring finger.

ATTACH_RHIP.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right hip.

ATTACH_RIGHT_PEC.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right pectoral.

ATTACH_RLARM.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right lower arm.

ATTACH_RLLEG.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right lower leg.

ATTACH_RPEC.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's left pectoral (deprecated, use ATTACH_LEFT_PEC).

ATTACH_RSHOULDER.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right shoulder.

ATTACH_RUARM.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right upper arm.

ATTACH_RULEG.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right upper leg.

ATTACH_RWING.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's right wing.

ATTACH_TAIL_BASE.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's tail base.

ATTACH_TAIL_TIP.tooltip: Attachment point for the avatar's tail tip.

BEACON_MAP.tooltip: Causes llMapBeacon to optionally display and focus the world map on the avatar's viewer.

CAMERA_ACTIVE.tooltip: Option flag used with llSetCameraParams to turn scripted control of the camera on or off.

CAMERA_BEHINDNESS_ANGLE.tooltip: Sets the angle in degrees within which the camera is not constrained by changes in target rotation.

CAMERA_BEHINDNESS_LAG.tooltip: Sets how strongly the camera is forced to stay behind the target if outside of the behindness angle.

CAMERA_DISTANCE.tooltip: Sets how far away the camera wants to be from its target.

CAMERA_FOCUS.tooltip: Sets camera focus (target position) in region coordinates.

CAMERA_FOCUS_LAG.tooltip: Sets how much the camera lags as it aims toward the target.

CAMERA_FOCUS_LOCKED.tooltip: Option flag used with llSetCameraParams to lock the camera focus so it does not move.

CAMERA_FOCUS_OFFSET.tooltip: Adjusts the camera focus position relative to the target.

CAMERA_FOCUS_THRESHOLD.tooltip: Sets the radius of a sphere around the camera's target position within which its focus is not affected by target motion.

CAMERA_PITCH.tooltip: Adjusts the angular amount that the camera aims straight ahead versus straight down, maintaining the same distance (analogous to 'incidence').

CAMERA_POSITION.tooltip: Sets camera position in region coordinates.

CAMERA_POSITION_LAG.tooltip: Sets how much the camera lags as it moves toward its ideal position.

CAMERA_POSITION_LOCKED.tooltip: Option flag used with llSetCameraParams to lock the camera position so it does not move.

CAMERA_POSITION_THRESHOLD.tooltip: Sets the radius of a sphere around the camera's ideal position within which it is not affected by target motion.

CHANGED_ALLOWED_DROP.tooltip: Object inventory changed because a user other than the owner (or the owner if the object is no-mod) added an item. This is only possible if enabled via llAllowInventoryDrop.

CHANGED_COLOR.tooltip: Object's Blinn-Phong color or alpha parameters have changed.

CHANGED_INVENTORY.tooltip: Prim inventory has changed by someone who has modification rights to it.

CHANGED_LINK.tooltip: Number of prims making up the object or avatars seated on it has changed. Also occurs when duplicating a linked object or when a prim changes type or shape. Does not trigger on attach/detach, sit/unsit in attachments, or single prim duplication.

CHANGED_MEDIA.tooltip: Prim Media on the prim has changed.

CHANGED_OWNER.tooltip: Object has changed owners. Triggers in the original object when a user takes it, copies it, or deeds it to a group, and in the new object when it is first rezzed.

CHANGED_REGION.tooltip: Object has changed regions by crossing a boundary or teleporting (if attached). Triggers only in the root prim of a linkset.

CHANGED_REGION_START.tooltip: Region containing this object has just come online.

CHANGED_RENDER_MATERIAL.tooltip: Render material (prim material ID or material overrides) has changed on one or more faces.

CHANGED_SCALE.tooltip: Prim scale of at least one prim in the linked object has changed. Only the root prim receives this event.

CHANGED_SHAPE.tooltip: Prim base shape (PRIM_TYPE, such as box, prism, torus, taper, twist, or cut) has changed.

CHANGED_TELEPORT.tooltip: Avatar this object is attached to has teleported. Triggers only in the root prim of an attachment. Does not occur for child prims or 'sit teleports'. If scripts are disabled at the destination, the event queues and triggers after moving to a script-enabled parcel.

CHANGED_TEXTURE.tooltip: Prim texture parameters (shine/bump settings, repeats, flip, rotation, offset, or texture) have changed.

CHARACTER_ACCOUNT_FOR_SKIPPED_FRAMES.tooltip: If set to FALSE, the pathfinding character will not attempt to catch up on lost time when performance is low, potentially providing more reliable (though potentially more stuttery) movement. Default is TRUE.

CHARACTER_AVOIDANCE_MODE.tooltip: Specifies which objects a pathfinding character avoids (other characters, dynamic obstacles like fast-moving objects and avatars, or both). Combined using bit flags; setting to AVOID_NONE disables avoidance for both categories.

CHARACTER_CMD_JUMP.tooltip: Makes the character jump. Requires a height parameter between 0.1m and 2.0m as the first element of the llExecCharacterCmd option list.

CHARACTER_CMD_SMOOTH_STOP.tooltip: Stops any current pathfinding operation in a smooth fashion.

CHARACTER_DESIRED_SPEED.tooltip: Constant used to indicate that the following argument is the desired speed (or speed of pursuit in meters per second) for a pathfinding character.

CHARACTER_DESIRED_TURN_SPEED.tooltip: Specifies the character's maximum speed while turning about the Z-axis (default is 6 meters/second). Note that this is only loosely enforced, and a character may turn at higher speeds under certain conditions.

CHARACTER_LENGTH.tooltip: Sets the collision capsule length for a pathfinding character. If the value is less than twice the radius plus 0.1m, it automatically adjusts to twice the radius plus 0.1m.

CHARACTER_MAX_ACCEL.tooltip: Specifies the character's maximum acceleration rate (default is 20 m/s²).

CHARACTER_MAX_DECEL.tooltip: Specifies the character's maximum deceleration rate (default is 30 m/s²).

CHARACTER_MAX_SPEED.tooltip: Specifies the character's maximum speed (must be between 0.2 and 50 meters/second; default is 20 m/s). Affects speed when avoiding dynamic obstacles and when traversing low-walkability objects in TRAVERSAL_TYPE_FAST mode.

CHARACTER_MAX_TURN_RADIUS.tooltip: Specifies the character's turn radius when traveling at CHARACTER_DESIRED_TURN_SPEED (default is 1.25 meters).

CHARACTER_ORIENTATION.tooltip: Specifies the orientation of the collision capsule for a pathfinding character to denote how to interpret its size. Valid options are VERTICAL and HORIZONTAL.

CHARACTER_RADIUS.tooltip: Sets the collision capsule radius used to define the size of a pathfinding character.

CHARACTER_STAY_WITHIN_PARCEL.tooltip: Determines whether a character is restricted to its starting parcel (default is FALSE). If TRUE, parcel boundaries act as one-way obstacles; the character cannot voluntarily leave and pathfinding behaviors (wander, flee, evade, pursue) will only choose goal points within the parcel. If pushed out, it can re-enter but cannot voluntarily leave again.

CHARACTER_TYPE.tooltip: Specifies the preferred surface and terrain terrain-type for the character (default is CHARACTER_TYPE_NONE). Used to describe preferred surfaces rather than behavior (e.g., cows prefer type B, sheep herded along a road prefer type C).

CHARACTER_TYPE_A.tooltip: Used for pathfinding character types that prefer movement consistent with humanoids.

CHARACTER_TYPE_B.tooltip: Used for pathfinding character types that prefer movement consistent with wild animals or off-road vehicles.

CHARACTER_TYPE_C.tooltip: Used for mechanical pathfinding character types or road-going vehicles.

CHARACTER_TYPE_D.tooltip: Used for pathfinding character types that are inconsistent with types A, B, or C.

CHARACTER_TYPE_NONE.tooltip: Used to set no specific pathfinding character type.

CLICK_ACTION_BUY.tooltip: Opens the buy dialog when the prim is clicked or touched.

CLICK_ACTION_DISABLED.tooltip: Disables click actions. No touches are detected or passed.

CLICK_ACTION_IGNORE.tooltip: Disables click actions. Clicks pass through the object to whatever is behind it, and no touches are detected.

CLICK_ACTION_NONE.tooltip: Performs the default action: triggers touch events when the prim is clicked or touched.

CLICK_ACTION_OPEN.tooltip: Opens the object inventory dialog when the prim is clicked or touched.

CLICK_ACTION_OPEN_MEDIA.tooltip: Opens the web media dialog or plays parcel media (without pausing) when the prim is touched.

CLICK_ACTION_PAY.tooltip: Opens the pay dialog when the prim is clicked or touched.

CLICK_ACTION_PLAY.tooltip: Enables HTML-on-a-prim or plays/pauses parcel media when the prim is clicked or touched.

CLICK_ACTION_SIT.tooltip: Causes the avatar to sit on the prim when it is clicked or touched.

CLICK_ACTION_TOUCH.tooltip: Triggers touch events when the prim is clicked or touched.

CLICK_ACTION_ZOOM.tooltip: Zooms the avatar camera in on the object (Viewer 2) when clicked or touched.

COMBAT_CHANNEL.tooltip: A region-wide channel reserved for combat-related log events. Passing this to llRegionSay adds the message to the combat log, and scripts listening on this channel can monitor the combat log.

COMBAT_LOG_ID.tooltip: ID used by all combat log messages sent from the region to the COMBAT_CHANNEL. Scripts can filter llListen calls with this ID to receive only system-generated combat log messages.

CONTENT_TYPE_ATOM.tooltip: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/atom+xml'.

CONTENT_TYPE_FORM.tooltip: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'.

CONTENT_TYPE_HTML.tooltip: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'text/html'. Only valid for embedded browsers on content owned by the viewer; falls back to 'text/plain' otherwise.

CONTENT_TYPE_JSON.tooltip: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/json'.

CONTENT_TYPE_LLSD.tooltip: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/llsd+xml' (Linden Lab Structured Data).

CONTENT_TYPE_RSS.tooltip: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/rss+xml'.

CONTENT_TYPE_TEXT.tooltip: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'text/plain'.

CONTENT_TYPE_XHTML.tooltip: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/xhtml+xml'.

CONTENT_TYPE_XML.tooltip: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/xml'.

CONTROL_BACK.tooltip: Tests for the avatar move back control (↓ or S).

CONTROL_DOWN.tooltip: Tests for the avatar move down control (PgDn or C).

CONTROL_FWD.tooltip: Tests for the avatar move forward control (↑ or W).

CONTROL_LBUTTON.tooltip: Tests for the avatar left mouse button control.

CONTROL_LEFT.tooltip: Tests for the avatar move left control (Shift + ← or Shift + A).

CONTROL_ML_LBUTTON.tooltip: Tests for the avatar left mouse button control while in mouselook.

CONTROL_RIGHT.tooltip: Tests for the avatar move right control (Shift + → or Shift + D).

CONTROL_ROT_LEFT.tooltip: Tests for the avatar rotate left control (← or A).

CONTROL_ROT_RIGHT.tooltip: Tests for the avatar rotate right control (→ or D).

CONTROL_UP.tooltip: Tests for the avatar move up control (PgUp or E).

DAMAGEABLE.tooltip: Identifies objects in the world that can process damage. In llDetectedType, it indicates a damageable agent, or an object containing a script with on_damage or final_damage events. Can also filter llSensor/llSensorRepeat calls.

DAMAGE_TYPE_ACID.tooltip: Damage caused by a caustic substance, such as acid.

DAMAGE_TYPE_BLUDGEONING.tooltip: Damage caused by a blunt object, such as a club.

DAMAGE_TYPE_COLD.tooltip: Damage inflicted by exposure to extreme cold.

DAMAGE_TYPE_FIRE.tooltip: Damage inflicted by exposure to heat or flames.

DAMAGE_TYPE_FORCE.tooltip: Damage inflicted by a great force or impact (Vertical Sim / SLMC).

DAMAGE_TYPE_IMPACT.tooltip: System damage generated by impact with land, terrain, or a prim.

DAMAGE_TYPE_NECROTIC.tooltip: Damage caused by a direct assault on the life-force.

DAMAGE_TYPE_PIERCING.tooltip: Damage caused by a piercing object such as a bullet, spear, or arrow (Vertical Sim / SLMC).

DAMAGE_TYPE_PSYCHIC.tooltip: Damage caused by a direct assault on the mind.

DAMAGE_TYPE_RADIANT.tooltip: Damage caused by radiation or extreme light.

DAMAGE_TYPE_SLASHING.tooltip: Damage caused by a slashing object such as a sword or axe.

DAMAGE_TYPE_SONIC.tooltip: Damage caused by loud noises, like a Crash Worship concert.

DATA_BORN.tooltip: Used with llRequestAgentData to return the agent's account creation ('born on') date as a string in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), based on Pacific Time (not UTC).

DATA_NAME.tooltip: Used with llRequestAgentData to return the requested agent's legacy name.

DATA_ONLINE.tooltip: Used with llRequestAgentData to return whether the requested agent is online (returns an integer boolean string: TRUE if online, FALSE if offline).

DATA_PAYINFO.tooltip: Used with llRequestAgentData to return a string containing the integer mask flag for payment status (contains PAYMENT_INFO_ON_FILE, PAYMENT_INFO_USED, or both).

DATA_RATING.tooltip: Deprecated. Used with llRequestAgentData to return the string '0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0'. It formerly returned a comma-separated list of positive and negative ratings (behavior, appearance, and building) before ratings were removed from SL.

DATA_SIM_POS.tooltip: Used with llRequestSimulatorData to return the region's global position as a vector.

DATA_SIM_RATING.tooltip: Used with llRequestSimulatorData to return the simulator rating string ('PG', 'MATURE', 'ADULT', or 'UNKNOWN').

DATA_SIM_STATUS.tooltip: Used with llRequestSimulatorData to return the simulator status as a string.

DEBUG_CHANNEL.tooltip: A chat channel reserved for script debugging and error messages. Passing this to llSay, llWhisper, or llShout prints text to the Script Warning/Error Window and broadcasts it to nearby avatars' script consoles.

DEG_TO_RAD.tooltip: Constant 0.017453293 (precise value is PI/180). Multiply a value in degrees by this number to convert it to radians.

DENSITY.tooltip: Used with llSetPhysicsMaterial to indicate that the density parameter is enabled (which overrides the previous value). Must be between 1.0 and 22587.0 kg/m³.

DEREZ_DIE.tooltip: Used with llDerezObject to immediately delete (kill) the object.

DEREZ_MAKE_TEMP.tooltip: Used with llDerezObject to mark the object as temporary, allowing the simulator to clean it up at a later time.

DEREZ_TO_INVENTORY.tooltip: Used with llDerezObject to return the targeted object to the rezzer's (derezzer's) inventory, saving its current state.

ENVIRONMENT_DAYINFO.tooltip: Day cycle and time information: day_length (seconds in the environment's day cycle), day_offset (seconds offset from GMT), and secs_since_midnight (seconds elapsed since the last day cycle midnight).

ENV_INVALID_AGENT.tooltip: Unable to find the specified agent, or could not find an agent with the specified ID.

ENV_INVALID_RULE.tooltip: There was an issue with one of the rules, or an attempt was made to change an unknown property.

ENV_NOT_EXPERIENCE.tooltip: Attempted to change environments outside an experience, or the script is not running as part of an experience with a valid experience key.

ENV_NO_ENVIRONMENT.tooltip: Environmental settings inventory object could not be found, or there is no environment on this parcel to modify.

ENV_NO_EXPERIENCE_LAND.tooltip: Experience has not been enabled or cannot run on the land.

ENV_NO_EXPERIENCE_PERMISSION.tooltip: Agent has not granted permission to change environments.

ENV_NO_PERMISSIONS.tooltip: Script lacks permissions to modify the environment at this location, or an attempt was made to remove altitude track 0 or 1.

ENV_OK.tooltip: Agent, parcel, or region will attempt to change the applied environment.

ENV_THROTTLE.tooltip: Scripts have exceeded the throttle limit. Wait and retry the request.

ENV_VALIDATION_FAIL.tooltip: Could not validate the environmental settings or values passed.

EOF.tooltip:
Value returned by llGetNotecardLine (through the dataserver event) and llGetNotecardLineSync when the requested line is past the end of the notecard. Equal to three newline characters ("


").

ERR_GENERIC.tooltip: An inexplicable and generic error where nothing is known about the cause.

ERR_MALFORMED_PARAMS.tooltip: Return value for llReturnObject* functions indicating that the parameters passed are malformed.

ERR_PARCEL_PERMISSIONS.tooltip: Return value for llReturnObject* functions indicating a lack of permissions to perform the task on the specified parcel.

ERR_RUNTIME_PERMISSIONS.tooltip: Return value for llReturnObject* functions indicating the script lacks the runtime permissions required to perform the requested task.

ERR_THROTTLED.tooltip: Return value for llReturnObject* functions indicating that the task has been throttled and should be retried later.

ESTATE_ACCESS_ALLOWED_AGENT_ADD.tooltip: Used as an input parameter for llManageEstateAccess to add an agent to the estate's Allowed Residents list.

ESTATE_ACCESS_ALLOWED_AGENT_REMOVE.tooltip: Used as an input parameter for llManageEstateAccess to remove an agent from the estate's Allowed Residents list.

ESTATE_ACCESS_ALLOWED_GROUP_ADD.tooltip: Used as an input parameter for llManageEstateAccess to add a group to the estate's Allowed Groups list.

ESTATE_ACCESS_ALLOWED_GROUP_REMOVE.tooltip: Used as an input parameter for llManageEstateAccess to remove a group from the estate's Allowed Groups list.

ESTATE_ACCESS_BANNED_AGENT_ADD.tooltip: Used as an input parameter for llManageEstateAccess to add an agent to the estate's Banned Residents list.

ESTATE_ACCESS_BANNED_AGENT_REMOVE.tooltip: Used as an input parameter for llManageEstateAccess to remove an agent from the estate's Banned Residents list.

FALSE.tooltip: Constant representing a boolean FALSE value. Used in conditional structures or variables to improve readability over the integer value (0).

FILTER_FLAGS.tooltip: Flags used to control which attachments are returned.

FILTER_FLAG_HUDS.tooltip: Filter flag used with llGetAttachedListFiltered to include HUDs with matching experiences in the returned result.

FILTER_INCLUDE.tooltip: Filter parameter used to include a specific attachment point.

FORCE_DIRECT_PATH.tooltip: Forces the pathfinding character to navigate in a straight line toward the specified position (can be set to TRUE or FALSE).

FRICTION.tooltip: Used with llSetPhysicsMaterial to enable the friction override. The value must be between 0.0 and 255.0.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_ADVANCE.tooltip: Forward/backward movement. Modal axis index 1 for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, and CAPTIVE modes.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_BOOM.tooltip: Camera up/down movement. Modal axis index 4 for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_DOLLY.tooltip: Camera forward/backward movement. Modal axis index 1 for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_LEFTX.tooltip: Left stick X axis. Canonical axis index 0.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_LEFTY.tooltip: Left stick Y axis. Canonical axis index 1.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_LOOK.tooltip: Looking up/down. Modal axis index 3 for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_PAN.tooltip: Camera pan left/right. Modal axis index 2 for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_RIGHTX.tooltip: Right stick X axis. Canonical axis index 2.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_RIGHTY.tooltip: Right stick Y axis. Canonical axis index 3.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_RISE.tooltip: Up/down movement. Modal axis index 4 for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, and CAPTIVE modes.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_ROLL.tooltip: Camera roll. Modal axis index 5 for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_STRAFE.tooltip: Left/right movement. Modal axis index 0 for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, and CAPTIVE modes.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_TILT.tooltip: Camera tilt up/down. Modal axis index 3 for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_TRIGGERLEFT.tooltip: Left trigger. Canonical axis index 4 (deprecated, use GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER).

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_TRIGGERRIGHT.tooltip: Right trigger. Canonical axis index 5 (deprecated, use GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER).

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_TRUCK.tooltip: Camera lateral (left/right) movement. Modal axis index 0 for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_TURN.tooltip: Turning left/right. Modal axis index 2 for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_ZOOM.tooltip: Camera zoom in/out. Modal axis index 6 for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and FLYCAM modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_ADVANCE_BACK.tooltip: Move backward. Modal button for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_ADVANCE_FORWARD.tooltip: Move forward. Modal button for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_CROUCH.tooltip: Crouch. Modal button for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_CURSOR_BUTTON_LEFT.tooltip: Left mouse button click. Modal button for MOUSELOOK and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_CURSOR_BUTTON_RIGHT.tooltip: Right mouse button click. Modal button for MOUSELOOK and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_DOLLY_BACK.tooltip: Camera dolly backward. Modal button for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_DOLLY_FORWARD.tooltip: Camera dolly forward. Modal button for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_JUMP.tooltip: Jump. Modal button for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_PAN_LEFT.tooltip: Camera pan left. Modal button for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_PAN_RIGHT.tooltip: Camera pan right. Modal button for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_RESET.tooltip: Reset camera to default view. Modal button for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_ROLL_CCW.tooltip: Roll camera counter-clockwise. Modal button for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_ROLL_CW.tooltip: Roll camera clockwise. Modal button for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_SIT.tooltip: Toggle sitting. Modal button for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_STRAFE_LEFT.tooltip: Strafe left. Modal button for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_STRAFE_RIGHT.tooltip: Strafe right. Modal button for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_TOGGLE_ALT_ZOOM.tooltip: Toggle alt-zoom. Modal button for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_TOGGLE_CURSOR.tooltip: Toggle cursor mode. Modal button for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_TOGGLE_FLYCAM.tooltip: Toggle flycam mode. Modal button for all modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_TOGGLE_FOLLOW.tooltip: Toggle camera follow mode. Modal button for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_TOGGLE_MOUSELOOK.tooltip: Toggle mouselook mode. Modal button for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_TOGGLE_SPEAK.tooltip: Toggle voice speak. Modal button for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and CURSOR modes.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_TRUCK_LEFT.tooltip: Camera truck left. Modal button for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_TRUCK_RIGHT.tooltip: Camera truck right. Modal button for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_ZOOM_IN.tooltip: Zoom camera in. Modal button for FLYCAM mode.

GAME_CONTROL_BUTTON_ZOOM_OUT.tooltip: Zoom camera out. Modal button for FLYCAM mode.

GCNP_RADIUS.tooltip: Used with llGetClosestNavPoint to limit how far out to search for a navigation point.

GCNP_STATIC.tooltip: Used with llGetClosestNavPoint to specify that the test should use the static navmesh, ignoring all dynamic obstacles.

GRAVITY_MULTIPLIER.tooltip: Used with llSetPhysicsMaterial to enable the gravity multiplier override. The value must be between -1.0 and +28.0.

HORIZONTAL.tooltip: Constant indicating that the collision capsule orientation for a pathfinding character is horizontal.

HTTP_ACCEPT.tooltip: Used with llHTTPRequest to override the default Accept header with custom MIME types (such as application/json, text/html, etc.). Responses with unlisted content types will return status 415.

HTTP_BODY_MAXLENGTH.tooltip: Sets the maximum (UTF-8 encoded) byte length of the HTTP response body. The maximum limit depends on the VM being used (Mono Max: 16384 bytes, LSO Max: 4096 bytes).

HTTP_BODY_TRUNCATED.tooltip: Indicates the response body truncation point in bytes.

HTTP_CUSTOM_HEADER.tooltip: Adds custom HTTP headers to the request (up to 8 per request). At the SLua level, provide a string-keyed table mapping header names to values; the serializer emits one HTTP_CUSTOM_HEADER/key/value triple per entry. Some default or sensitive headers are blocked for security reasons.

HTTP_EXTENDED_ERROR.tooltip: If set to TRUE, llHTTPRequest always returns a key. If an error occurs during the request, detailed error information (delivered in an RFC 7807 JSON block) is reported through the http_response event using that key.

HTTP_METHOD.tooltip: Specifies the HTTP method ('GET', 'POST', 'PUT', or 'DELETE') for the request.

HTTP_MIMETYPE.tooltip: Specifies the request Content-Type MIME type. Text types should define a charset (e.g., 'text/plain;charset=utf-8'). Use 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' to emulate HTML forms.

HTTP_PRAGMA_NO_CACHE.tooltip: Controls whether the 'Pragma: no-cache' header is sent with the HTTP request. When SendHeader is TRUE (default), the header is sent; when FALSE, it is omitted.

HTTP_USER_AGENT.tooltip: Appends a custom string to the default LSL User-Agent header value. Must follow HTTP standard syntax (e.g., 'My-Script-Name/1.0'). Spaces are not allowed and will cause a script error; use hyphens instead.

HTTP_VERBOSE_THROTTLE.tooltip: If set to TRUE, shouts error messages to DEBUG_CHANNEL if the outgoing request rate exceeds the server limit. If FALSE, these error messages are suppressed.

HTTP_VERIFY_CERT.tooltip: If set to TRUE, the server's SSL certificate must be verifiable using a standard certificate authority when making HTTPS requests. If FALSE, any SSL certificate is accepted.

INVENTORY_ALL.tooltip: Used with inventory functions to specify that all types of inventory items should be retrieved.

INVENTORY_ANIMATION.tooltip: Used with inventory functions to filter or retrieve items of the ANIMATION type.

INVENTORY_BODYPART.tooltip: Used with inventory functions to filter or retrieve items of the BODYPART type.

INVENTORY_CLOTHING.tooltip: Used with inventory functions to filter or retrieve items of the CLOTHING type.

INVENTORY_GESTURE.tooltip: Used with inventory functions to filter or retrieve items of the GESTURE type.

INVENTORY_LANDMARK.tooltip: Used with inventory functions to filter or retrieve items of the LANDMARK type.

INVENTORY_MATERIAL.tooltip: Used with inventory functions to filter or retrieve items of the MATERIAL type.

INVENTORY_NONE.tooltip: Value returned by inventory functions indicating that the specified inventory item does not exist.

INVENTORY_NOTECARD.tooltip: Used with inventory functions to filter or retrieve items of the NOTECARD type.

INVENTORY_OBJECT.tooltip: Used with inventory functions to filter or retrieve items of the OBJECT type.

INVENTORY_SCRIPT.tooltip: Used with inventory functions to filter or retrieve items of the SCRIPT type.

INVENTORY_SETTING.tooltip: Used with inventory functions to filter or retrieve items of the SETTING type.

INVENTORY_SOUND.tooltip: Used with inventory functions to filter or retrieve items of the SOUND type.

INVENTORY_TEXTURE.tooltip: Used with inventory functions to filter or retrieve items of the TEXTURE type.

JSON_APPEND.tooltip: A specifier for llJsonSetValue indicating the given value should be appended to the array at the specified level. If the target value is not an array, the existing data will be overwritten and replaced by the new array.

JSON_ARRAY.tooltip: Used with llList2Json to indicate that the provided list should be encoded and returned as a string-serialized JSON array.

JSON_DELETE.tooltip: A constant used to delete a value within a JSON text string.

JSON_FALSE.tooltip: Return value for llJsonValueType indicating that the value at the specified address in a JSON string is a boolean FALSE.

JSON_INVALID.tooltip: Indicates an invalid state or parameter. Returned by llList2Json when inputs are not well-formed, by llJsonValueType for an invalid JSON type, or by llJsonGetValue when attempting to access a nonexistent location.

JSON_NULL.tooltip: Return value for llJsonValueType indicating that the value at the specified address in a JSON string is a JSON null.

JSON_NUMBER.tooltip: Return value for llJsonValueType indicating that the value at the specified address in a JSON string is a number.

JSON_OBJECT.tooltip: Used with llList2Json to indicate that the provided list is a strided list of key-value pairs to be encoded and returned as a JSON object.

JSON_STRING.tooltip: Return value for llJsonValueType indicating that the value at the specified address in a JSON string is a string.
