TARGETED_EMAIL_ROOT_CREATOR.tooltip: Flag used with llTargetedEmail to send the email message to the creator of the root object.

TERRAIN_DETAIL_1.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the texture or material (via UUID, inventory name, or default NULL_KEY/empty string) for terrain detail layer 1.

TERRAIN_DETAIL_2.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the texture or material (via UUID, inventory name, or default NULL_KEY/empty string) for terrain detail layer 2.

TERRAIN_DETAIL_3.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the texture or material (via UUID, inventory name, or default NULL_KEY/empty string) for terrain detail layer 3.

TERRAIN_DETAIL_4.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the texture or material (via UUID, inventory name, or default NULL_KEY/empty string) for terrain detail layer 4.

TERRAIN_HEIGHT_RANGE_NE.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the north-east height range for texture blending. Specifies low as the maximum height for texture 1, high as the minimum height for texture 4, and lets textures 2 and 3 mix in between.

TERRAIN_HEIGHT_RANGE_NW.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the north-west height range for texture blending. Specifies low as the maximum height for texture 1, high as the minimum height for texture 4, and lets textures 2 and 3 mix in between.

TERRAIN_HEIGHT_RANGE_SE.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the south-east height range for texture blending. Specifies low as the maximum height for texture 1, high as the minimum height for texture 4, and lets textures 2 and 3 mix in between.

TERRAIN_HEIGHT_RANGE_SW.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the south-west height range for texture blending. Specifies low as the maximum height for texture 1, high as the minimum height for texture 4, and lets textures 2 and 3 mix in between.

TERRAIN_PBR_OFFSET_1.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV offset vector (ignoring the Z component) for drawing terrain layer 1. Only works for PBR textures.

TERRAIN_PBR_OFFSET_2.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV offset vector (ignoring the Z component) for drawing terrain layer 2. Only works for PBR textures.

TERRAIN_PBR_OFFSET_3.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV offset vector (ignoring the Z component) for drawing terrain layer 3. Only works for PBR textures.

TERRAIN_PBR_OFFSET_4.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV offset vector (ignoring the Z component) for drawing terrain layer 4. Only works for PBR textures.

TERRAIN_PBR_ROTATION_1.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the rotation of the PBR texture for layer 1, in radians. Only works for PBR textures.

TERRAIN_PBR_ROTATION_2.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the rotation of the PBR texture for layer 2, in radians. Only works for PBR textures.

TERRAIN_PBR_ROTATION_3.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the rotation of the PBR texture for layer 3, in radians. Only works for PBR textures.

TERRAIN_PBR_ROTATION_4.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the rotation of the PBR texture for layer 4, in radians. Only works for PBR textures.

TERRAIN_PBR_SCALE_1.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV scale vector (repeats per meter, ignoring the Z component) for terrain layer 1. Only works for PBR textures.

TERRAIN_PBR_SCALE_2.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV scale vector (repeats per meter, ignoring the Z component) for terrain layer 2. Only works for PBR textures.

TERRAIN_PBR_SCALE_3.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV scale vector (repeats per meter, ignoring the Z component) for terrain layer 3. Only works for PBR textures.

TERRAIN_PBR_SCALE_4.tooltip: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV scale vector (repeats per meter, ignoring the Z component) for terrain layer 4. Only works for PBR textures.

TEXTURE_BLANK.tooltip: Asset UUID representing the default 'Blank' texture.

TEXTURE_MEDIA.tooltip: Asset UUID representing the default 'Default Media' texture.

TEXTURE_PLYWOOD.tooltip: Asset UUID representing the default 'Plywood' texture.

TEXTURE_TRANSPARENT.tooltip: Asset UUID representing the '*Default Transparent Texture' in the library (included with viewers).

TOUCH_INVALID_FACE.tooltip: Value returned by llDetectedTouchFace when the touch position is not valid.

TOUCH_INVALID_TEXCOORD.tooltip: Value returned by llDetectedTouchUV and llDetectedTouchST when the touch position is not valid.

TOUCH_INVALID_VECTOR.tooltip: Value returned by llDetectedTouchPos, llDetectedTouchNormal, and llDetectedTouchBinormal when the touch position is not valid.

TP_ROUTING_BLOCKED.tooltip: Teleport routing setting indicating that direct teleporting is blocked on the parcel.

TP_ROUTING_FREE.tooltip: Teleport routing setting indicating that teleports are unrestricted on the parcel.

TP_ROUTING_LANDINGP.tooltip: Teleport routing setting indicating that teleports are routed to the parcel's landing point (if one has been set).

TRANSFER_BAD_OPTS.tooltip: Inventory transfer error code indicating that an invalid option was passed in the options list.

TRANSFER_BAD_ROOT.tooltip: Inventory transfer error code indicating that the root path specified in TRANSFER_DEST was invalid or resolved to nothing.

TRANSFER_DEST.tooltip: Inventory option specifying the destination root folder to transfer inventory into.

TRANSFER_FLAGS.tooltip: Inventory parameter specifying flags to control the behavior of inventory transfers.

TRANSFER_FLAG_COPY.tooltip: Inventory transfer flag that copies the transferred object and places it in the recipient's inventory (implies TRANSFER_FLAG_TAKE).

TRANSFER_FLAG_RESERVED.tooltip: Inventory transfer flag reserved for future expansion; do not use.

TRANSFER_FLAG_TAKE.tooltip: Inventory transfer flag that automatically removes the object from the world and places it in the recipient's inventory once accepted.

TRANSFER_NO_ATTACHMENT.tooltip: Inventory transfer error code indicating ownership of an attached object cannot be transferred.

TRANSFER_NO_ITEMS.tooltip: Inventory transfer error code indicating that the list was empty or contained only non-transferable items.

TRANSFER_NO_PERMS.tooltip: Inventory transfer error code indicating the object lacks transfer permissions.

TRANSFER_NO_TARGET.tooltip: Inventory transfer error code indicating the receiving agent could not be found in the current region.

TRANSFER_OK.tooltip: Status code indicating that the inventory transfer was successful or the transfer offer was successfully made.

TRANSFER_THROTTLE.tooltip: Inventory transfer error code indicating that the transfer rate has exceeded the inventory transfer throttle.

TRAVERSAL_TYPE.tooltip: Pathfinding parameter specifying the character's movement traversal type. Expects TRAVERSAL_TYPE_SLOW (default), _FAST, or _NONE.

TRUE.tooltip: Mnemonic constant representing a boolean TRUE value (integer 1). Used in conditional structures or variables to improve script readability.

TWO_PI.tooltip: Mathematical constant pi*2, representing the number of radians in a full circle.

TYPE_FLOAT.tooltip: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is a float.

TYPE_INTEGER.tooltip: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is an integer.

TYPE_INVALID.tooltip: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is invalid.

TYPE_KEY.tooltip: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is a key.

TYPE_ROTATION.tooltip: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is a rotation.

TYPE_STRING.tooltip: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is a string.

TYPE_VECTOR.tooltip: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is a vector.

VEHICLE_ANGULAR_DEFLECTION_EFFICIENCY.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 to 1.0) acting as a scalar to modulate the strength of angular deflection, reorienting the vehicle's preferred axis toward its true velocity.

VEHICLE_ANGULAR_DEFLECTION_TIMESCALE.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the vehicle to achieve full angular deflection, reorienting its preferred axis of motion to match its true velocity.

VEHICLE_ANGULAR_FRICTION_TIMESCALE.tooltip: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the timescales (range [0.07, infinity) seconds per axis) for the exponential decay of angular velocity about the vehicle's preferred axes (at, left, up).

VEHICLE_ANGULAR_MOTOR_DECAY_TIMESCALE.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale (in seconds) for the angular motor's magnitude and effectiveness to decay toward zero.

VEHICLE_ANGULAR_MOTOR_DIRECTION.tooltip: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the direction and magnitude of the angular velocity (in radians per second) that the vehicle's angular motor attempts to achieve.

VEHICLE_ANGULAR_MOTOR_TIMESCALE.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the vehicle's angular motor to achieve full power and velocity.

VEHICLE_BANKING_EFFICIENCY.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter (range -1.0 to 1.0) controlling banking efficiency, where negative values lean out of turns and positive values lean into turns. This parameter makes banking affect steering; use angular motors to bank. 0.0 means no banking.

VEHICLE_BANKING_MIX.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 (static) to 1.0) (dynamic) controlling the mix between static banking (scales only with roll angle) and dynamic banking (additionally scales with linear speed).

VEHICLE_BANKING_TIMESCALE.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the banking behavior to take full effect. This is another way to scale the strength of the banking effect, however it affects the term that is proportional to the difference between what the banking behavior is trying to do, and what the vehicle is actually doing.

VEHICLE_BUOYANCY.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter (range -1.0 to 1.0) defining buoyancy, where -1.0 represents double gravity and 1.0 represents full anti-gravity.

VEHICLE_FLAG_BLOCK_INTERFERENCE.tooltip: Vehicle flag that prevents attachments worn by passengers from pushing the vehicle via llPushObject or other scripting functions.

VEHICLE_FLAG_CAMERA_DECOUPLED.tooltip: Vehicle flag used with mouselook steering/banking. When set, the passenger's mouselook camera rotates independently of the vehicle's orientation.

VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_GLOBAL_HEIGHT.tooltip: Vehicle flag that forces the hover behavior to maintain a global height rather than hovering relative to the ground or water.

VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_TERRAIN_ONLY.tooltip: Vehicle flag that forces the hover behavior to ignore water height and hover exclusively relative to the terrain/land.

VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_UP_ONLY.tooltip: Vehicle flag preventing hover from pushing downward, allowing hovering vehicles to jump or fly above their designated hover height.

VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_WATER_ONLY.tooltip: Vehicle flag that forces the hover behavior to ignore terrain height and hover exclusively relative to water.

VEHICLE_FLAG_LIMIT_MOTOR_UP.tooltip: Vehicle flag that prevents ground vehicles from motoring upward into the sky. When combined with banking, banking strength decays when the vehicle is airborne (no longer colliding) to prevent steering mid-jump.

VEHICLE_FLAG_LIMIT_ROLL_ONLY.tooltip: Vehicle flag for vehicles with a vertical attractor that need to climb or dive, allowing airplanes to use the banking feature.

VEHICLE_FLAG_MOUSELOOK_BANK.tooltip: Vehicle flag that enables mouselook control, remapping left-right camera motions (yaw) to rotations about the vehicle's local X-axis.

VEHICLE_FLAG_MOUSELOOK_STEER.tooltip: Vehicle flag that enables steering via mouse, directing the angular motor to align the vehicle's local X-axis with the direction of the client-side camera.

VEHICLE_FLAG_NO_DEFLECTION_UP.tooltip: Vehicle flag that prevents linear deflection parallel to the world Z-axis, preventing ground vehicles (such as bumper cars) from climbing into the sky.

VEHICLE_HOVER_EFFICIENCY.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 to 1.0) controlling hover damping, where 0.0 is bouncy and 1.0 is critically damped.

VEHICLE_HOVER_HEIGHT.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the height at which the vehicle attempts to hover. Set to 0.0 to disable hover.

VEHICLE_HOVER_TIMESCALE.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the timescale (period of time in seconds) for the vehicle to achieve its hover height.

VEHICLE_LINEAR_DEFLECTION_EFFICIENCY.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 to 1.0) modulating the efficiency and strength of linear deflection. That is, its a simple scalar for modulating the strength of linear deflection.

VEHICLE_LINEAR_DEFLECTION_TIMESCALE.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the vehicle to redirect its linear velocity along its preferred X-axis. It is another way to specify how much time it takes for the vehicle's linear velocity to be redirected to its preferred axis of motion.

VEHICLE_LINEAR_FRICTION_TIMESCALE.tooltip: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the timescales (range [0.07, infinity) seconds per axis) for the exponential decay of linear velocity along the vehicle's preferred axes (at, left, up).

VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_DECAY_TIMESCALE.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale (in seconds) for the linear motor's magnitude and effectiveness to decay toward zero.

VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_DIRECTION.tooltip: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the direction and magnitude of the linear velocity (range [0, 30] m/s) that the vehicle's linear motor attempts to achieve.

VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_OFFSET.tooltip: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the offset from the vehicle's center of mass where the linear motor force is applied.

VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_TIMESCALE.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the vehicle to reach its full linear motor velocity.

VEHICLE_REFERENCE_FRAME.tooltip: Vehicle rotation parameter setting the orientation of the vehicle's preferred axes of motion (at, left, up) relative to its local geometric frame (x, y, z).

VEHICLE_TYPE_AIRPLANE.tooltip: Vehicle type constant for aircraft that use linear deflection for lift, banking to turn, and no hover.

VEHICLE_TYPE_BALLOON.tooltip: Vehicle type constant for balloons that use hover and friction but no deflection.

VEHICLE_TYPE_BOAT.tooltip: Vehicle type constant for boats that hover over water with high friction and minor angular deflection.

VEHICLE_TYPE_CAR.tooltip: Vehicle type constant for land vehicles that bounce along the ground and rely on external controls or timer events to drive their motors.

VEHICLE_TYPE_NONE.tooltip: Constant used to disable and turn off vehicle physics support on the object.

VEHICLE_TYPE_SLED.tooltip: Vehicle type constant for sliding vehicles that bump along the ground and prefer to move along their local X-axis.

VEHICLE_VERTICAL_ATTRACTION_EFFICIENCY.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 to 1.0) controlling vertical attraction stability (0.0 is wobbly/bouncy, 1.0 is critically damped/firm) to keep the vehicle upright.

VEHICLE_VERTICAL_ATTRACTION_TIMESCALE.tooltip: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale (in seconds) for the vehicle to rotate and align its local Z-axis (up) with the world Z-axis (vertical).

VERTICAL.tooltip: Constant indicating that the collision capsule orientation for a pathfinding character is vertical.

WANDER_PAUSE_AT_WAYPOINTS.tooltip: Option parameter for llWanderWithin specifying whether the character should pause briefly after reaching each wander waypoint.

WATER_BLUR_MULTIPLIER.tooltip: Environmental setting specifying the multiplier applied to blur the scene when underwater.

WATER_FOG.tooltip: Environmental underwater fog parameters: color, density exponent, and modulation.

WATER_FRESNEL.tooltip: Environmental water surface Fresnel scattering parameters: offset and scale.

WATER_NORMAL_SCALE.tooltip: Environmental setting specifying the scaling vector applied to the water normal map.

WATER_NORMAL_TEXTURE.tooltip: Environmental setting containing the inventory name or UUID of the normal map texture used for water waves.

WATER_REFRACTION.tooltip: Environmental water surface refraction scale factors: scale_above and scale_below.

WATER_TEXTURE_DEFAULTS.tooltip: Environmental check returning 1 if default water wave maps are used, or 0 if a custom texture is set.

WATER_WAVE_DIRECTION.tooltip: Environmental wave direction vectors (X is east/west, Y is north/south) specifying speeds and directions for both large and small waves.

XP_ERROR_EXPERIENCE_DISABLED.tooltip: Experience owner has temporarily disabled the experience.

XP_ERROR_EXPERIENCE_SUSPENDED.tooltip: Experience has been suspended by Linden Lab customer support.

XP_ERROR_INVALID_EXPERIENCE.tooltip: Script is associated with an experience that no longer exists.

XP_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETERS.tooltip: One of the string arguments was too big to fit in the key-value store.

XP_ERROR_MATURITY_EXCEEDED.tooltip: Content rating of the experience exceeds that of the region.

XP_ERROR_NOT_FOUND.tooltip: Sim was unable to verify the validity of the experience. Retrying after a short wait is advised.

XP_ERROR_NOT_PERMITTED.tooltip: This experience is not allowed to run by the requested agent, or experience permissions were denied by the user.

XP_ERROR_NOT_PERMITTED_LAND.tooltip: Experience is blocked or not enabled for this land, or is not allowed to run in the current region.

XP_ERROR_NO_EXPERIENCE.tooltip: This script is not associated with an experience.

XP_ERROR_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.tooltip: An attempt to write data to the key-value store failed due to the data quota being met.

XP_ERROR_REQUEST_PERM_TIMEOUT.tooltip: Request for experience permissions was ignored and the request timed out without modification.

XP_ERROR_RETRY_UPDATE.tooltip: A checked update failed due to an out of date request.

XP_ERROR_STORAGE_EXCEPTION.tooltip: Unable to communicate with the key-value store, or attempted to create a key that already exists.

XP_ERROR_STORE_DISABLED.tooltip: Key-value store is currently disabled on this region.

XP_ERROR_THROTTLED.tooltip: Call failed due to too many recent calls.

XP_ERROR_UNKNOWN_ERROR.tooltip: An unknown error occurred that is not covered by any of the other predetermined error states.

ZERO_ROTATION.tooltip: A rotation constant representing an identity rotation (causes no change). This is the default value for rotation variables.

ZERO_VECTOR.tooltip: A vector constant representing <0.0, 0.0, 0.0>. This is the default value for vector variables.
